data.summary: An Attached unit carries [every keyword](vsdata:core-rule/keywords) belonging to each unit it is built from, so a rule aimed at units having one of those keywords affects the Attached unit as a whole. Individual models, though, never pick up keywords held only by other models in the unit; bear in mind that attacks are aimed at units rather than models. For example, while a **PSYKER** **LEADER** model belongs to an Attached unit, the unit counts as **PSYKER** even if its **BODYGUARD** models lack that keyword, so against a weapon with **[[ANTI-PSYKER 4+]](vsdata:core-rule/anti)** an unmodified wound result of 4 or more becomes a [Critical Wound](vsdata:core-rule/wound-rolls) even when the attack goes to a model other than that **LEADER**.

unitKeywords.attachedUnitHas: all keywords of all its component units

example.condition: while that LEADER model is part of the unit

result.evenIfAllocatedTo: a model other than the LEADER
